在「收款渠道」里选中它。选中的渠道没配好时，会自动退到下一个已配置的，最后是手动: Select it under Payment channel. If the selected channel isn't set up, it falls back to the next configured one, then to manual confirmation.
用小额真实支付走一遍，到「订单」确认到账。: Make a small real payment and confirm it shows up under Orders.
1 点卖多少分钱（最小货币单位）。币种默认 USD，可用 TAVERN_PAYM: How many cents (smallest currency unit) one point costs. Currency defaults to USD; change it with TAVERN_PAYMENT_CURRENCY.
留「自动」时用列表里第一个已配置的渠道。: On Auto, the first configured channel in the list is used.
给任何支持「带参数跳转 + HMAC 签名回调」的网关用，回调地址是 /api/: For any gateway that supports a redirect with parameters plus an HMAC-signed callback. The callback URL is /api/payments/hosted.
不接任何网关，玩家下单后由管理员在「订单」里手动确认到账，适合内测。: No gateway. After a player places an order, an admin confirms payment manually under Orders. Good for closed beta.
Stripe 对成人内容有限制，上线前先和 Stripe 确认；不行就需要高风险: Stripe restricts adult content, so check with Stripe before launch. If it's not allowed, you'll need a high-risk payment provider, connected the same way as the hosted checkout.
拉新和留存用的福利。所有数字填 0 就是关闭，玩家端不会显示对应入口。改动立即生: Perks for acquisition and retention. Set any number to 0 to turn it off, and players won't see that entry point. Changes apply immediately.
先只开「每日免费额度」，让新玩家不用充值也能体验。: Start with just the daily free allowance so new players can try it without paying.
有了支付后再开「首充赠送」。: Turn on the first top-up bonus once payments work.
需要拉新时开邀请：见面礼给被邀请人，奖励给邀请人，返点按好友充值比例给。: For growth, turn on referrals: a welcome gift for the invitee, a reward for the inviter, and a rebate on the friend's top-ups.
每人每天生成时先抵扣这么多点，按平台时区零点刷新（默认 UTC，TAVERN_T: Each player gets this many points per day, used before their balance. Resets at midnight platform time (UTC by default; change with TAVERN_TIMEZONE).
第一笔充值到账时额外送的百分比。: Extra percentage added to a player's first top-up.
用好友链接注册就到账。: Credited as soon as they sign up through a friend's link.
好友第一次生成后到账；每位邀请人最多拿几次。: Credited after the friend's first generation; the cap is how many times one inviter can earn it.
好友每笔充值按比例返给邀请人，退款时扣回；期限是好友注册后多少天内的充值才返，0: A share of each of the friend's top-ups goes to the inviter and is clawed back on refund. The window is how many days after sign-up top-ups count; 0 means no limit.
奖励在好友第一次真正生成后才发，并有次数上限；可疑账号可在「玩家」里封禁。: Rewards only pay out after the friend's first real generation, and they're capped. Ban suspicious accounts under Players.
控制每次发给模型的历史有多长。越长记得越多，但每次扣的点也越多。: Controls how much history is sent to the model each turn. Longer means better memory, but more points per turn.
在「模型广场」给每个模型填上限（如 200K）。: Set a limit for each model in Model plaza (e.g. 200K).
这里设置没标上限时的默认值，以及全站封顶。: Here you set the default for models without a limit, and a site-wide cap.
玩家可以在预设里把 context_size 调小，但不会超过模型上限和全站封顶: Players can lower context_size in their presets, but never above the model limit or the site cap.
模型广场里没填上限的模型用这个值，默认 32K。: Used for models with no limit in Model plaza. Defaults to 32K.
留空不封顶；设了以后任何模型、任何玩家都不能超过它。可写 32K、1M 或纯数字: Blank means no cap. Once set, no model or player can exceed it. Use 32K, 1M or a plain number.
开启后，对话页会出现「生图」按钮，按当前剧情生成一张插图。不配置就不显示这个按钮: When on, chat gets a Generate image button that illustrates the current scene. Without it, the button is hidden.
准备一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /images/generations 接口（如: Have an OpenAI-compatible /images/generations endpoint ready (gpt-image-1 or any compatible gateway).
填 Base URL 和 API Key，点「获取模型」从上游拉取后选择，拉不到: Enter the Base URL and API key, click Fetch models to pick from the upstream, or type one in if it can't be fetched.
设置尺寸和每张扣点，点「测试」会真实生成一张。: Set the size and points per image. Test generates a real image.
留空时用文本模型的 Key 兜底。只写不读。: If blank, the text model's key is used. Write-only.
按「站点与服务 → 媒体存储」的设置，存在本地磁盘或 R2/S3。: Per Site & services → Media storage: on local disk or in R2/S3.
开启后，消息旁会出现朗读按钮。用 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/speec: When on, messages get a read-aloud button. Uses an OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint and outputs mp3.
填 Base URL、API Key 和模型名（如 tts-1）。: Enter the Base URL, API key and model name (e.g. tts-1).
填音色（如 alloy），设置每次扣点。: Enter a voice (e.g. alloy) and the points per read.
点「测试」试听一段。: Click Test to hear a sample.
上游支持的音色名，角色卡里没指定时用这个。: A voice name the upstream supports, used when the character card doesn't specify one.
每朗读一条消息扣多少点；单条最多读 2000 字。: Points per message read aloud; up to 2,000 characters per message.
配好后，聊天的「记忆检索」用向量相似度从很早的楼层里找回相关内容；不配就用关键词: Once set up, memory recall in chat uses vector similarity to find relevant content from far back. Without it, keyword matching is used. Embeddings don't cost players points; the site pays for them.
准备 OpenAI 兼容的 /embeddings 接口，例如 text-emb: Have an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint ready, such as text-embedding-3-small or bge-m3.
向量按「内容 + 模型」缓存；换模型后会在用到时按新模型重新计算。: Vectors are cached by content plus model; after switching models they're recomputed with the new model as needed.
用于注册验证和找回密码。配好 Resend 会真的发信；没配时邮件写到服务器的: Used for sign-up verification and password resets. With Resend set up, mail really goes out; otherwise it's written to .data/outbox/ on the server, which is only good for local testing.
在 Resend 注册并添加你的发信域名，按提示在 DNS 里加 SPF / D: Sign up at Resend, add your sending domain, add the SPF / DKIM records to DNS as instructed, and wait for the domain to verify.
在 Resend 创建 API Key，填到下面。: Create an API key in Resend and paste it below.
发件人写成「夜话 <no-reply@你的域名>」，域名必须是已验证的那个。: Set the sender as "Yehua <no-reply@your-domain>" using the verified domain.
用「忘记密码」给自己发一封试试。: Send yourself a Forgot password email to test it.
显示名加地址，地址的域名要在 Resend 验证过。: Display name plus address; the address's domain must be verified in Resend.
只写不读，留空不改。: Write-only; leave blank to keep it.
这些信息会写进《用户协议》《隐私政策》和帮助页。现在的协议是模板，正式上线前要让: This goes into the Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Help pages. The current terms are a template; have a lawyer review them for your entity and region before launch.
填运营主体的法定名称和客服邮箱，最少这两项。: At minimum, fill in the operator's legal name and a support email.
海外运营建议单独留一个法务与隐私邮箱，处理数据删除和版权投诉。: For overseas operation, keep a separate legal and privacy email for data deletion and copyright requests.
管辖地建议用英文写（例如 State of Delaware, USA），中英文: Write the jurisdiction in English (e.g. State of Delaware, USA); it's shown as entered on both Chinese and English pages.
法务确认后填更新日期，打开「法务已审核」，三个法务页就不再显示「模板文本」提示。: After legal sign-off, set the updated date and turn on Reviewed by legal so the three legal pages stop showing the template notice.
出现在协议「运营方与联系方式」一节和隐私政策的数据处理者。: Shown in the Operator and contact section of the terms, and as the data controller in the privacy policy.
帮助页的支持邮箱，也是推送的默认联系地址。: The support email on the Help page, and the default contact for push.
留空用客服邮箱。: Leave blank to use the support email.
填了才会出现「适用法律与争议解决」一节。: The Governing law section only appears once this is filled in.
协议正文怎么改？: How do I edit the terms themselves?
正文在 app/terms、app/privacy、app/guidelines: The text lives in the app/terms, app/privacy and app/guidelines page files. Replace it once legal gives you final wording.
信用卡在线支付。玩家点充值会跳到 Stripe 的结账页，付款后 Stripe: Online card payments. Top-up sends the player to Stripe Checkout; after payment Stripe calls back and points are credited automatically.
在 Stripe 后台 Developers → API keys 复制 Sec: In the Stripe dashboard, copy the Secret key from Developers → API keys (sk_test_ for testing, sk_live_ for production).
在 Developers → Webhooks 新建端点，地址填你的域名加 /a: Under Developers → Webhooks, add an endpoint at your domain plus /api/payments/stripe with the checkout.session.completed event.
复制该端点的 Signing secret（whsec_ 开头）。: Copy that endpoint's Signing secret (starts with whsec_).
两项都填好保存，再到「计费与增长 → 支付渠道」选中 Stripe。: Save both, then select Stripe under Billing & growth → Payment channel.
先用测试 key 和测试卡 4242 4242 4242 4242 走一遍，确认: Run through it with test keys and the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, confirm the order is credited, then switch to live keys.
用于创建结账会话。只写不读。: Used to create checkout sessions. Write-only.
用于校验回调确实来自 Stripe，没有它订单不会到账。: Verifies callbacks really come from Stripe; without it orders won't be credited.
多半是 webhook 没配对：检查地址、事件类型和签名密钥；Stripe 后台: Usually the webhook is misconfigured: check the URL, event type and signing secret. Stripe's Webhooks page shows the result of every callback.
Stripe 对成人内容有限制，务必先确认你的业务被允许。: Stripe restricts adult content, so confirm your business is allowed first.
头像、立绘、生图和语音文件默认存在服务器的 .data/media。用户多了建议: Avatars, sprites, generated images and audio are stored in .data/media on the server by default. As you grow, move to object storage so the disk doesn't fill up and servers are easy to move.
Cloudflare R2：在 R2 新建 Bucket，在「管理 R2 API: Cloudflare R2: create a bucket, then under Manage R2 API tokens create a token with read/write access to it.
Endpoint 填 https://<账户ID>.r2.cloudflares: Set Endpoint to https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com and Region to auto.
AWS S3 的 Endpoint 填 https://s3.<区域>.amaz: For AWS S3, Endpoint is https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com with the matching Region.
填好后点「测试读写」，会写入并删除一个小文件。: Click Test read/write, which writes and deletes a small file.
存储方式留「自动」即可，配好就会切到对象存储；之后新上传的文件存到对象存储，旧文: Leave Storage on Auto; it switches to object storage once configured. New uploads go to object storage; existing files are still read locally.
文件在 Bucket 里的目录，默认 media/。: The folder inside the bucket; defaults to media/.
打开后本地也留一份做缓存，读取更快，但占磁盘。: Keeps a local copy as a cache: faster reads, more disk.
Bucket 要设成公开吗？: Does the bucket need to be public?
不用。文件统一经由站点的 /media 路由读取，Bucket 保持私有即可。: No. Files are always served through the site's /media route, so keep the bucket private.
每天把数据库和媒体打包备份。SQLite 是整个站的全部数据，没有异地备份，服务: Backs up the database and media every day. SQLite holds the whole site; without off-site backups, losing the server means losing everything.
新建一个专门放备份的 Bucket，不要和媒体共用，并给它单独的读写令牌。: Create a bucket just for backups, separate from media, with its own read/write token.
把 Endpoint、Bucket 和令牌填到这里。: Fill in the Endpoint, Bucket and token here.
在服务器上执行 crontab -e，加一行：0 3 * * * cd 你的站点: On the server, run crontab -e and add: 0 3 * * * cd /path/to/site/app && npm run backup
可以先手动跑一次 npm run backup，回到这里看「上次备份」是否显示成: Run npm run backup once by hand, then check that Last backup here says succeeded and uploaded.
服务器 .backups 目录里的备份保留多久，默认 14 天；对象存储里的不会: How long backups stay in .backups on the server; 14 days by default. Copies in object storage aren't deleted; set a lifecycle rule on the bucket.
停掉站点，把备份的 tavern-日期.db.gz 解压成 .data/tave: Stop the site, unzip the tavern-date.db.gz backup to .data/tavern.db, extract the media archive into .data/, and start it again.
有。数据库里存着后台填的各种密钥，所以备份 Bucket 一定要私有。: Yes. The database holds every key entered in the admin, so the backup bucket must be private.
服务端或玩家浏览器里出错时，把错误推到你的群机器人，第一时间知道站点出了问题。所: When something breaks on the server or in a player's browser, the error is posted to your chat bot so you know right away. Every error is also logged to .data/logs/errors.log on the server.
Slack：建一个 Incoming Webhook；Discord：频道设置: Slack: create an Incoming Webhook. Discord: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks.
飞书、企业微信、钉钉：在群里添加自定义机器人，复制 Webhook 地址。: Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk: add a custom bot to the group and copy its webhook URL.
填进来保存，点「发一条测试告警」，到群里确认收到。: Paste it here, save, click Send a test alert, and check the group.
同一个错误 5 分钟内只推一次。: The same error is sent at most once every 5 minutes.
角色发布、导入和对话消息会先过一遍 OpenAI 的 moderation 接口: Character publishing, imports and chat messages go through OpenAI's free moderation API first, and anything in a blocked category is stopped. By default only sexual content involving minors is blocked, the baseline for an adult platform.
在 OpenAI 后台创建一个 API Key，填进来就启用。: Create an API key in OpenAI and paste it here to turn it on.
需要更严格时，在「拦截类别」里用逗号追加，例如 self-harm/instru: For stricter rules, add categories separated by commas, e.g. self-harm/instructions, violence/graphic.
被拦截的内容会提示作者修改；接口出错时放行并发告警，不影响正常聊天。: Blocked content asks the author to revise. If the API errors, content goes through and an alert is sent, so chat isn't interrupted.
一般不用改；用兼容网关时再改。: Usually leave as is; change only for a compatible gateway.
类别名以 OpenAI moderation 文档为准。: Category names follow OpenAI's moderation docs.
玩家把站点装到桌面（PWA）并允许通知后，有新作品、点数到账、审核结果等通知时会: Once players install the site (PWA) and allow notifications, new characters, points credited, review results and other notices are pushed to their phone or computer. Standard Web Push, no third-party service.
VAPID 密钥第一次使用时已经自动生成，并存在数据库里，重启不会变。: VAPID keys were generated on first use and stored in the database, so restarts don't change them.
联系地址建议填客服邮箱，浏览器厂商在推送异常时会联系这个地址。: Use your support email as the contact; push services use it if there's a problem with your pushes.
真机测试：手机上用浏览器打开站点，添加到主屏幕，在「我的」里打开通知。: Real-device test: open the site in a phone browser, add it to the home screen, and turn on notifications under Me.
什么时候需要重新生成密钥？: When should I regenerate the keys?
只有密钥泄露时。重新生成后所有已订阅设备失效，玩家要重新打开通知。: Only if they leak. Regenerating invalidates every subscribed device, and players have to turn notifications on again.
部分地区（例如英国、美国部分州）法律要求成人内容先做强年龄验证。在「内容管理 →: Some regions (e.g. the UK and some US states) require strong age verification for adult content. In regions marked Requires verification under Content → Content rating, players see 18+ content only after verifying.
先在「内容分级」里确定哪些地区完全不提供、哪些需要验证。: First decide under Content rating which regions get no adult content and which require verification.
目前没有接入验证服务商，需要验证地区的玩家只能由管理员在玩家详情里手动标记已验证: No verification provider is connected yet, so players in those regions can only be marked verified manually by an admin on their detail page.
选定服务商（如 Yoti、Veriff、AgeChecked）后，在 lib/a: Once you pick a provider (e.g. Yoti, Veriff, AgeChecked), connect it by adding one adapter file in lib/age-verify/.
支持 PNG、JPG、WebP、GIF，可裁剪、旋转和调色: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF. Crop, rotate and adjust colors.
这张图片打不开，换一张试试: Couldn't open this image. Try another one.
拖动图片调整位置，滚轮或滑杆缩放。: Drag to reposition. Scroll or use the slider to zoom.
恢复成默认头像（昵称首字）？: Reset to the default avatar (your initial)?
请选择 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF 图片: Please choose a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF image

只支持 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF 图片: Only PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF images are supported
换得太频繁了，过一会儿再试: Too many changes. Try again in a while.
拖动调整位置，滚轮或方向键微调: Drag to reposition; scroll or arrow keys to fine-tune
比例 5:2，下方约一半会渐隐成透明，头像和昵称压在上面。: 5:2. The lower half fades out, with your avatar and name on top.
角色对话、群聊、总结: role-play chats, group rooms and summaries
长期记忆与资料库检索: long-term memory and data bank search
系统在后台自动调用，不单独扣点: Called automatically in the background; no extra charge
按张：每生成一张图固定扣点: Per image: a fixed charge for each image
按次：每朗读一条固定扣点: Per use: a fixed charge for each reply read aloud
生图模型，用于对话里的插图和场景图: Image model for illustrations and scenes in chats
语音模型，把角色的回复朗读出来: Voice model that reads character replies aloud
向量模型，让角色记住更久以前的剧情、检索资料库: Embedding model that helps characters remember earlier story and search your data bank
去掉头像，改用昵称首字？: Remove your avatar and use your initial?

对话模型未配置，没法自动写画面描述: No chat model is set up, so the scene can't be described automatically
点数不足，没法写画面描述: Not enough points to describe the scene
模型没写出画面描述，换个方式再试: The model didn't return a description. Try another option.
生图还没开通：请管理员在后台「接口配置 · 生图」里填好: Image generation isn't set up yet. An admin needs to fill it in under Settings › Image.
还没有角色卡？填名字、简介和开场白就能发布。: No character card yet? Add a name, a hook and an opening line, and you can publish.

开：带上角色图，保持长相一致: On: send the character's image so they look the same
开启后，角色有封面或头像时会把它当参考图传给 /images/edits，画出来: When on, a character's cover or avatar is sent to /images/edits as a reference, so pictures show the same face. Characters without an image use the first portrait drawn in that chat. If the provider doesn't support edits, it falls back to normal generation.
设为定妆照：以后生图照这张的长相画: Set as reference look: future pictures keep this face

本群聊第一张 TA 的立绘: their first portrait in this group chat
